published_reference.note: Corrected on 2026-08-27 to final-epoch metrics, so these now use the same protocol as the trials and are directly comparable. Earlier revisions reported 0.688 and 0.707 via best-epoch selection on the evaluation set.

measured_baseline.note: Default config scored through this framework. Screen averages 3 seeds, so it sits below the single-seed 0.677 of baseline_gcn_v1; the LOSO figures differ slightly from experiments/ because of run-to-run and device variation.

current_sota.note: Gates were raised on 2026-09-20 to the Fisher-z incumbent (iter6). Later trials must beat this, not the original 0.63 LOSO baseline. Loop stop remains loso-full accuracy_mean >= 0.80.
current_sota.name: iter6_fisher-z-transform-arctanh-with-

screen.rationale: Raised from 0.64 after iter6. Must clear the Fisher-z screen (0.673) within cheap-stage noise rather than the original 3-seed baseline (0.628). 0.66 still sits below typical current screens (~0.67) so it stays a filter, not the destination.

loso-subset.rationale: Raised from 0.67 after iter6 (subset 0.753). The old 0.67 no longer filtered anything on the Fisher-z stack. 0.72 is above the original subset baseline (0.659) and below the incumbent subset, so a candidate must show a real cross-site gain before the full sweep.

loso-full.rationale: Raised from 0.66 to the iter6 Fisher-z incumbent (0.6895, accuracy 0.644). Clearing the original 0.63+0.03 bar is no longer enough to open a PR. Loop stop is still accuracy_mean >= 0.80; this gate is the new state of the art, not the clinical 80/80 bar.
